Reference No. 1 to the prescribed procedure to be followed before payment of salaries and non-salaried dues of teachers / non-teaching staff in Special Non-Government Schools / Workshops for Persons with Disabilities. Directions have been issued vide Government Circular No. 1 dated 02.01.2026, to examine and submit proposals as per the prescribed Scrutiny List.

Accordingly, as per the non-payment proposal of Shri Balwantrao Pasarkar Educational Institute Budhwara Amravati Operated Shri Laxmikant Pasarkar Mukabadhir Vidyalaya Amravati, received by the Department from the Commissioner, Divyang Kalyan, Pune, funds are being disbursed for grant-in-aid (Programme), 31-Auxiliary Grants (Non-Payment) to Non-Governmental Organizations working for persons with disabilities as follows.
